brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: One editorial basketball article thumbnail, Japanese, landscape 16:9, 1792x1024 or preferably 1920x1080, width above 1000 pixels.
Primary request: Create ONE finished image with all typography integrated. Ink and brush illustration, not a photo. The article is a PRE-GAME selection of registered players based on season-average EFF, for 2026-11-20 B.ONE. No result or individual achievement claim.

Visual references already inspected in this conversation: the approved black/lime Culver thumbnail is STYLE ONLY (heavy Japanese typography, charcoal background, energetic lime brush stroke, few elements, orange ball, hand-inked illustrated athlete); do NOT carry over its name, score, date, pose or likeness. The official portrait of Cameron Jackson is LIKENESS ONLY. Do not paste either reference image or official photo into the output.

Subject: Draw the REAL basketball player Cameron Jackson / キャメロン・ジャクソン (B.LEAGUE player 51000319), one person only, unmistakably an illustration. Preserve his official portrait features: medium-brown skin, shoulder-length brown-black locs swept back from a fairly high forehead, loose locs beside both ears reaching shoulders with slightly lighter brown tips, oval rounded face with full cheeks, thick gently arched eyebrows, almond eyes, broad rounded nose, moustache and a short compact chin goatee. Strong broad shoulders and powerful muscular upper body. Do NOT substitute a generic athlete with short curls or a different face. His likeness is based on the official portrait just inspected. This player was randomly selected among names in the fixed article, so he is an illustrative motif only. DO NOT print his name, number, team, individual stats, or claims about his appearance/performance.

Composition: Left 57% is strong typographic hierarchy; right 43% is the illustrated player in an energetic low driving dribble, knees flexed, torso leaning forward toward the viewer, face visible in a mild three-quarter angle and eyes focused ahead. His right hand controls the orange basketball beside his right hip, left arm naturally bent for balance. Ball is a held/controlled prop. Keep head, face, hands, fingers and ball entirely inside the canvas. The legs may blend into brush marks at the bottom edge, without awkward anatomical cuts. Hands anatomically plausible, five fingers each. Plain ivory jersey and shorts with charcoal trim; absolutely no logos, sponsorships, team words or jersey numbers. A sweeping diagonal lime brush mark behind the player gives movement. No other people, no audience, no scoreboard. This is an imagined generic basketball motion, NOT a recreated moment from an actual game.

Style/medium: Premium Japanese sports editorial poster, hand-drawn black ink outlines and dry-brush hatching, limited color screenprint feel, expressive yet recognizable face, off-white highlights, charcoal shadows, slightly rough paper texture. Not photographic, not 3D. Same art direction as the approved black/lime sample.
Palette: Deep charcoal #151A18, vivid lime #CCF43B, warm ivory, orange basketball. Large clean Japanese bold sans lettering, dry-brush texture only lightly on the huge numeral 5; no texture that harms reading.

Text (verbatim; render only these strings):
"11/20  B.ONE"
"今季平均EFFで選出"
"登録選手の"
"ベスト5"
"試合前の選出｜出場確定ではありません"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"イメージ"

Typography layout: Small top-left date and league line. Under it, medium lime text 今季平均EFFで選出. Center-left very bold ivory 登録選手の, then huge ベスト5 with the 5 in vivid lime. Main headline is dominant and legible at thumbnail size. Lower-left qualification 試合前の選出｜出場確定ではありません, clearly readable and comfortably above the bottom footer. Bottom-left small but easily readable labels イラスト（AI生成） and イメージ separated by generous space. Maintain safe margins on every text line, no overflow or overlap with athlete. All characters must be correct Japanese.
Constraints: No team logo, league logo, official photographs, watermarks or additional text. B.ONE is plain typeset text only. Do not show scores or individual data. Do not use 今日の結果, 活躍, 出場決定, or actual-event claims. Return one image only.

generator.qa_method: 生成画像の表示と保存元PNGを目視。文字・数字・留保・顔の特徴・手指・見切れ・ロゴなし・AI表記を確認。PNGヘッダー、寸法、コピー内容一致と固定HTMLのblob SHAを標準ライブラリで確認。
generator.style_note: 指定の白地参照A-faison-ivory-v3.pngはその場所に存在しなかったため、目視確認済みの黒ライム参照を使用。
